title: IRS: Instructions for Form 941 (Rev. March 2026), Paperwork Reduction Act notice and burden estimates

history.reason: Source read directly on the access date; findings transcribed from the document.

source_type: Government form instructions with burden estimates
reliability: Government document; the issuing agency is also the party imposing or administering the requirement. Publication date not shown beyond "Rev. March 2026".
findings: IRS burden estimates cover the Form 941 series and related employment tax forms, based on law as of October 1, 2025, and include time (recordkeeping, preparing and submitting forms, wage statements) and out-of-pocket costs.

IRS says the figures are national averages that do not necessarily reflect a typical employer, and that most employers experience lower than average burden, varying considerably with the number of Forms W-2 filed.
IRS example: an employer issuing four Forms W-2 has an estimated average burden of 63.6 hours (15.9 hours x 4) and $2,480 ($620 x 4).
IRS example: a large employer issuing 2,000 Forms W-2 has an estimated average burden of 800 hours (2,000 x 0.4) and $40,000 (2,000 x $20).
limitations: Model-based IRS estimates, not measured time; the underlying method was not examined.
Averages across all employer types; the instructions state many employers have lower burden.
Payroll software and service providers already serve this need; their adoption and coverage were not investigated.
